# GeomInstanceAPI

Native-instancing tag on an instance root. [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population writes it into [usd-schemas](prim.md#columns) of every instance root, whose [usd-prim-type](prim.md#columns) becomes XformInstance (or ScopeInstance) while the authored type moves to usd-metadata:typeName.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable), [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable), [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Read only when listed in `usd-schemas`.**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by ovstage population on every instance root, in every domain.

## Notes

- No [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema applies this name and it declares no column; the parser keys native instancing on the ovstage instancing queries (instance and prototype roots), not on attributes.
